infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Snap-to-Study AI uses your camera to scan textbook pages and study notes into flashcards.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Snap-to-Study AI accesses your photos so you can upload study notes from your gallery.
